b7de6936dcda505b.description:
Headquarters: Remote - North America

Why AssemblyAI

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. Our models serve 600M+ inference calls monthly, process 1M+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion+ end-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - with under 100 people generating roughly $600K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale - processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build,  this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. No matter your race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply!
About the Role

We're hiring our first Senior GTM AI Engineer. This is a software engineering job inside the revenue org. You will build the pipelines, internal tools, and agents that decide which companies we go after, how we reach them, and what our sellers see when they open their laptop in the morning.

Most of what a sales ops team used to do by hand is now something you can write software to do. Finding every company building voice AI before they contact us. Researching an account and drafting the first email. Watching product usage and telling an AE when a customer is about to expand or churn. Keeping the CRM clean without anyone filling in forms. You will build those systems, run them in production, and be judged on whether pipeline and revenue move.

Your users are our AEs, SDRs, and GTM leaders. Your job is to make a small team perform like one three times its size.

What You'll Do

• Write code every day. Python services, SQL models, scheduled jobs, and small internal apps are most of the job. You'll use Claude Code and similar tools to ship in days what used to take a quarter.

• Build agents that do the work: account research, lead qualification, outreach drafting, CRM hygiene, and usage monitoring. Design them, give them tools and data, evaluate their output, and keep them running.

• Turn product usage data in BigQuery and Looker into signals sellers act on: usage alerts, expansion triggers, and account health scores.

• Build the account targeting machine: sourcing, enrichment, dedupe, and ICP scoring, from raw data to a ranked list in a rep's queue.

• Integrate the systems the team already uses (our CRM, enrichment providers, outbound tools) so data moves between them without a human in the loop.

• Keep funnel data trustworthy: routing rules, field governance, and attribution.

• Prototype fast, measure what works, kill what doesn't, and work directly with Sales and Marketing leadership on what to build next.

• Document what you build so it keeps running without you.

What You'll Need

• 4+ years as a software engineer, data engineer, or growth/GTM engineer, with time spent shipping systems that other people depend on.

• Strong Python and SQL. You have owned production automations end to end: APIs, webhooks, scheduled jobs, retries, error handling, and monitoring.

• Experience building with LLMs beyond a single prompt: multi-step agents, tool use, retrieval, and evaluation. You can tell whether an agent's output is good, and you know when a plain script is the better tool.

• AI-assisted development is how you work. You use Claude Code or similar tools daily, and you have the engineering judgment to review, test, and stand behind what they produce.

• Solid fundamentals: clean code, version control, code review, debugging, and a habit of thinking in systems. You do not need an engineering team to ship.

• Curiosity about how a sales org works. You don't need a RevOps background, but you need to care about how deals get found and closed, and be willing to learn our CRM and the tools around it quickly.

• A builder's mindset with an operator's judgment: you scope for business impact, ship iteratively, and measure results in pipeline and revenue.

• Low ego, high ownership, and comfort being the single-threaded owner of an entire domain.

Nice to Have

• Hands-on Salesforce or other CRM work at the object and API level, or experience with enrichment and outbound tools like Clay.

• dbt, BigQuery, and Looker, or an equivalent warehouse and BI stack.

• Time at a developer-facing or API-first company, or selling to technical buyers.

• You've been the first engineer in a sales or growth org and built the function from scratch.

Pay Transparency:

AssemblyAI strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size, stage, and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefit, and other reward opportunities we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level, qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

The provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range which will be communicated to candidates throughout the interview process.

Salary range: $160,000 to $220,000

b723c13588968200.description: About RevOpt RevOpt is building a revenue-management platform to help hotels make better commercial decisions and grow revenue. We are hiring a hands-on Pricing & Revenue Optimization Scientist to work with our forecasting data scientist and hospitality-domain team. Our forecasting work is already underway. This role has a distinct purpose: decide what rate to recommend, under what constraints, and how to assess whether that decision works. It is not a second forecasting position, a competitor-price scraping role or a dashboard-only role. What you will do Build a first version of a hotel room-rate recommendation system using demand forecasts, on-the-books rooms, booking pace, remaining inventory and hotel-specific commercial rules. Define how rate floors and ceilings, permitted rate changes, room or segment differences, competitor signals and human approvals affect a recommendation. Investigate how booking demand may respond to changes in price, while recognising that historical prices were not set randomly. Start with clear, testable pricing logic; introduce more sophisticated optimisation where the data and product needs justify it. Simulate and evaluate recommendations against a credible baseline before putting them into a hotel’s workflow. Produce explainable outputs: the recommended rate, the principal reasons for it, the constraints applied and situations where the system should decline to recommend a change. Collaborate with our forecasting data scientist on inputs, interfaces and monitoring, and with the hospitality team on commercial logic. Implement tested, maintainable Python and SQL logic that our engineering team can integrate into RevOpt. What we are looking for Hands-on experience building a pricing, yield-management, revenue-management, inventory-allocation or decision-optimisation system—not just analysing or displaying prices. Strong Python and SQL, including the ability to work with messy operational data and write production-oriented code. Ability to state an optimisation objective, specify real business constraints and compare a proposed decision with a defensible baseline. Sound statistical judgment about evaluation, uncertainty and the limits of inferring price response from historical data. Clear communication with both technical colleagues and commercial decision-makers. Relevant experience in hotels, airlines, travel or another capacity-constrained business with perishable inventory is particularly welcome. Strong applied-pricing candidates from other sectors should also apply if they can demonstrate comparable decision-making work. Helpful experience Price-response or elasticity modelling. Constrained optimisation, simulation, experimentation or causal inference. Hotel revenue-management concepts such as occupancy, pickup, booking lead time, length of stay and rate restrictions. Designing human-reviewed recommendations before automating decisions. Important distinction Competitor-rate collection can be a useful input, but price comparison is not price optimisation. Likewise, a demand forecast alone does not determine the best room rate. We are looking for someone who can connect forecasts to constrained, measurable commercial decisions. Compensation and workplace ₹12–18 LPA CTC, depending on demonstrated experience and fit. This is a full-time, on-site role in Chennai. Please answer the below questions while applying for this position: Pricing ownership: “Describe one pricing, yield-management or optimisation system you personally built. What decision did it recommend or make, what objective did it pursue, and what were its business constraints?” Evidence of impact: “What baseline did you compare that system against, and how did you test whether its decisions improved the outcome? Please separate your contribution from the wider team’s work.” Practical fit: “Are you willing to work full-time on-site in Chennai, and is your expected annual CTC within ₹12–18 LPA?”

Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.

We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.

Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.

Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

The Role

The Customer Services department within ETG is dedicated to continuously elevating the customer experience through automation, process optimization, and quality governance.

We are seeking an inquisitive, detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our team in Mumbai. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in delivering actionable insights and robust reporting solutions to global stakeholders across the Customer Services organization, empowering data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

• Performance Reporting: Monitor, analyse, and report on core Customer Service KPIs and operational performance metrics across daily, weekly, and monthly intervals.
• Dashboard Development: Design, build, and maintain interactive productivity dashboards and visual analytics for cross-functional teams using BI tools (Qlik Sense).
• Data Management & Extraction: Write efficient SQL queries to extract, transform, and model complex, multidimensional datasets from relational databases to fulfil ad-hoc and routine business requests.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate directly with global business leads to understand data requirements, manage inbound reporting queues, and effectively communicate insights to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Continuous Improvement: Identify operational trends, inefficiencies, and data quality gaps to assist leadership in driving automation and workflow enhancements.

Requirements

• Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience in a Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, or Operational Reporting role (BPO / Contact Centre experience is highly advantageous).
• SQL Proficiency: Strong experience writing complex SQL queries for data extraction, aggregation, and analysis.
• BI Tools: Hands-on experience developing reports and dashboards in Qlik Sense / QlikView, Power BI, Tableau or Looker Studio (preferred).
• Advanced Spreadsheet Skills: Proficient in Excel and Google Sheets, including advanced formulas (INDEX/MATCH, XLOOKUP, nested logic), pivot tables, and data modelling.
• Data Handling: Proven ability to clean, manipulate, and draw insights from large, complex, and unaggregated datasets.

Key Competencies & Behavioural Traits

• Self-Driven & Proactive: Strong sense of ownership with a desire to impact organizational success.
• Agility: Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting business priorities.
• Good Communication: Able to articulate technical data findings clearly to global stakeholders at varying leadership levels.

Diversity disclaimer

At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds. During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.

Headquarters: Remote, United States

About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.
About the team/role

Checkr Trust is not a typical sales role. It's a chance to help build an entirely new business inside a category-defining company — and we're going deep on insurance.

Checkr Trust accelerates solutions that detect bad actors before they impact businesses. We have early traction in the insurance space, strong product-market pull, and the backing of Checkr — but we are still building the plane while flying it.

We are looking for a Senior Account Executive who knows the insurance industry from the inside: the players, the pain points, the buying dynamics, and the relationships. Someone who can walk into a room with a carrier, MGA, or program administrator and immediately earn credibility — not because of a slide deck, but because of deep domain fluency and a trusted network.

This role is for someone who wants:

• A difficult, high-ownership role

• Ambiguity over predictability

• Accountability over excuses

• Long-term impact over short-term comfort

This is not a "manage a book of inbound" job. This is a territory-building, market-educating, first-call-to-close ownership role within the insurance vertical. You will operate like a founder inside a startup — except you have the resources of an established company behind you.

If you want something safe and structured, this won't be the right fit. If you want to build something enduring in insurance — and are willing to do the hard work required — keep reading.

What You'll Do

• Own the insurance vertical: define ICPs across carriers, MGAs, program administrators, and insurtech platforms — then build repeatable motion where none exists yet

• Leverage your existing insurance relationships to accelerate pipeline and shorten deal cycles

• Own the entire deal lifecycle — from cold outreach to multi-threaded enterprise close

• Educate the market on a category that is still forming, translating Checkr Trust's value into the language of underwriting, loss prevention, and claims risk

• Navigate complex insurance buying processes involving underwriting, compliance, legal, and executive stakeholders

• Experiment with AI to find efficiencies across your work

• Partner cross-functionally with product, legal, operations, and leadership to shape how we win in insurance

• Hit ambitious revenue targets

Your fingerprints will be on how Checkr Trust wins in insurance.

What We're Looking For

You are someone who:

• Has 5–7+ years of full-cycle, quota-carrying sales experience — hunting required

• Has deep roots in the insurance industry

• Has sold six- or seven-figure deals in complex, multi-stakeholder environments

• Understands insurance workflows well enough to connect Checkr Trust's solutions to real underwriting and risk management problems

• Has built pipeline when there was no brand awareness in a market

• Has worked in a startup or operated like you were in one

• Has outperformed targets in situations that weren't perfectly set up for you

• Has tangible examples of projects created using advanced AI tactics

• Carries an A-player mindset: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes

More importantly:

• You have grit. Your energy and work ethic raises the bar of others

• You prefer autonomy and ownership to rigid structure

• You don't wait for perfect messaging — you test, iterate, refine

• You are comfortable hearing "no" repeatedly without losing momentum

• You care about building something meaningful, not just closing this quarter's deal

• You hold yourself to a higher internal standard than anyone else will

People describe you as relentless, disciplined, competitive — but collaborative. You understand that building something valuable in a complex, regulated industry like insurance is both rewarding and uncomfortable.
